contract: Approved compact Items mockup and docs/page-headers.md: seven main section patterns, shared 20px/14px typography, continuous artwork through tabs, desktop subtitle-to-tabs gap at most 8px, Items header at most 160px, natural mobile wrapping and RTL placement.

accessibility.evidence: Browser checks verified hidden decorative artwork, pointer-events:none, keyboard focus from Import to New, existing Forecasts arrow-key/tab behavior, shared font sizes and keyboard-accessible table scrolling. Rendered desktop/mobile/Arabic text fit was inspected; mobile controls retain 44px targets. No automated axe audit was run.

responsive.evidence: All seven sections rendered at English 1920/1366/375px and Arabic 1366/375px without page overflow or browser errors. Items measured 153px including global bar/tabs and a 6px subtitle gap. Existing responsive checks also passed at 768/1024/1440px.

loading.reason: The decorative header has no asynchronous image fetch or data state: artwork is synchronous inline SVG. Existing page loading behavior is retained.

empty.evidence: The new seven-section visual test captured authenticated empty-organization pages with their existing empty messages and actions.

error.reason: The header introduces no network operation, mutation or error-state controller; existing page error handling remains outside this presentation scope.

partial.reason: Patterns contain no operational quantities, optional business datasets or metric statuses. Partial-data semantics remain in existing page content.

success.evidence: Existing master-data workflows passed creation, duplicate refusal, editing, money formatting and deletion while using the new list headers; all six Forecasts panels retained form state.

permission.evidence: Existing viewer workflows passed read-only lists/settings, hidden New actions, disabled edit fields and refused new-form access. Organization-switch stale-form protection also passed.
